data.title: Iran's fmr. leader Khamenei's funeral begins third day with red vengeance flags | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: His funeral, delayed due to the ongoing war, began on Saturday with chants of "death to America, death to Israel," while the ceremonies are expected to last at least a week.
